model.description: P(interviewed) = logistic(a0 + a1*fit_6q + a2*s_j + a3*fit_6q*s_j). Fit from simulated competitive interview selection with 300 candidates, per-department normalisation, sigmoid transform, and top-k ranking. Department utility: U = v_i_bar^alpha * f_j^(1-alpha). Evaluated at calibrated quality level (v_i_bar = 0.86 ). Candidate preferences generated with quality-correlated distributions. 6Q fit uses: geographic setting, region (with signal dilution), teaching load, course types (D=neutral), PhD ratio, medical school (4-level gradient: Essential/VeryImportant/Moderate/NotImportant). All questions support 'No preference' options.
